name: uf2-export
description: Compile the current Arduino IDE 2.x sketch for the selected board and export a .uf2.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license -o uf2-export.vsix

uf2export.arduinoCliPath.markdownDescription: Path to `arduino-cli` for the fallback build. Empty: the CLI bundled with the IDE, else `arduino-cli` from PATH.

uf2export.buildMethod.markdownDescription: `auto`: IDE verify command, arduino-cli only if the command does not exist. `cli` always uses arduino-cli (board options come from the IDE selection).

uf2export.overrides.markdownDescription: Per-board mapping, keyed by FQBN without options, e.g. `{ "vendor:arch:board": { "familyId": "NRF52840", "input": "hex" } }`. `familyId`: number, `"0x…"` string or `short_name` from uf2families.json. `input`: `hex`, `bin` (needs `baseAddress`) or `uf2` (passthrough). Overrides win over built-in rules.
